extracted.intended_audience: AAAI-25 reviewers (program committee members and assigned reviewers)
extracted.subtask_description: Ethical and professional standards for reviewers evaluating submissions to the AAAI-25 conference, covering fairness, conflicts of interest, confidentiality, plagiarism detection, and professional responsibilities such as meeting deadlines and providing constructive feedback.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fairness and Professionalism
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewers must maintain fairness and objectivity while treating authors respectfully; provide constructive feedback in a professional and courteous manner.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus evaluations on the work's academic merits; avoid biased language or unprofessional tone. Offer constructive suggestions rather than personal criticism; strive to be unbiased and objective in judgments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflict of Interest Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewers must disclose potential conflicts and decline assignments where objectivity may be compromised.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include submissions from the reviewer's own institution or close collaborators. Reviewers should promptly inform the chairs and exclude themselves when conflicts arise; if conflicted, do not accept the assignment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoiding Bias from Personal Relationships
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not review submissions suspected to be authored by colleagues or close collaborators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a submission appears to come from someone with whom the reviewer has a personal or professional relationship that could bias evaluation, the reviewer should decline and notify chairs. This is an explicit safeguard against nepotism and friendship-based bias.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review Focus on Academic Merit (Avoid Personal Characteristics)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviews must focus solely on academic merit, excluding the authors' personal characteristics, affiliations, or backgrounds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate novelty, clarity, rigor, and relevance of the work rather than characteristics of the authors. Provide suggestions for improvement (e.g., methodological fixes, clarity) rather than critiques tied to identity, affiliation, or presumed motives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confidentiality and Integrity of the Review Process
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewers must protect the confidentiality of the review process and not use information for personal gain.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not share manuscripts, review content, or privileged submission details outside the review process. Treat submitted material as confidential; avoid using ideas or results from submissions for personal advantage before publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plagiarism Detection and Reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Carefully check submissions for any indications of plagiarism and report suspected instances immediately.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If plagiarism or other ethical breaches are suspected, inform the program chairs promptly with supporting evidence. Be diligent in checking citations, overlap with prior work, and signs of unattributed copying.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional Responsibility: Timeliness and Thoroughness
rubrics_metrics.description: All reviewers must meet deadlines and provide thorough feedback while upholding the highest standards of ethical conduct throughout the review process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit reviews by the specified deadlines; provide detailed, actionable comments that substantiate scores and recommendations. Uphold professional ethics in tone, content, and conduct during the entire review lifecycle.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adherence to Guidelines and Deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewers must adhere to the guidelines and deadlines set forth by the conference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow any procedural instructions from chairs (e.g., scoring rubrics, formatting, confidentiality procedures). Timely compliance with guidelines ensures fairness and efficiency of the review process.
